changelog:
- Restores the Caveman SDK resource loader configuration used for lean sessions.
- Separates built-in SDK tools from policy-wrapped custom tools and activates the complete mode surface.
- Reduces cold-session visual history replay from 64 KB to 12 KB.
- Adds per-run token, cache, context, tool-call, and local compression telemetry.
- Adds SDK contract and token telemetry regression tests.
